summary: Example Lightspeed inventory: an [ansiblelightspeed] host group plus lightspeed_admin_user, lightspeed_admin_password, lightspeed_admin_email, lightspeed_pg_host and lightspeed_pg_password.
questions: Show an inventory example for Ansible Lightspeed on containerized AAP
Which database variables does Lightspeed need?

answer_card.title: Lightspeed inventory basics
answer_card.answer_md:
```ini
[ansiblelightspeed]
aap.example.com

[all:vars]
lightspeed_admin_user=<set your own>
lightspeed_admin_password=<set your own>
lightspeed_admin_email=<set your own>
lightspeed_pg_host=<set your own>
lightspeed_pg_password=<set your own>
```
